items.description: Prepare a claim regarding the moisture issue for coal from hold no. 4 on VSL-13, documenting the discharge moisture of 11.2% against the load moisture of 9.0%.
Reply to the receiver's letter, acknowledging their claim of seawater ingress and reserving rights regarding the moisture issue.
Confirm receipt of the letter regarding the moisture issue in hold no. 4 and inform the counterparty of the steps being taken.
